sources.snippet: BETO is of size similar to a BERT-Base and was trained with the Whole Word Masking technique. Below you find Tensorflow and Pytorch checkpoints for the uncased and cased versions, as well as some results for Spanish benchmarks comparing BETO with Multilingual BERT as well as other (not BERT-based) models.

sources.title: bert-base-spanish-wwm-cased-finetuned-spa-squad2-es
sources.snippet: What is bert-base-spanish-wwm-cased-finetuned-spa-squad2-es? This is a specialized Spanish language model based on BETO (Spanish BERT) that has been fine-tuned specifically for question-answering tasks using the Spanish version of SQuAD2.0 dataset. The model utilizes whole word masking technique and maintains case sensitivity for enhanced performance in Spanish text understanding ...
